header.pastedTip: Opened from a pasted save code. Copy code gives it back with your changes.

dialog.compareTitle: Choose a save to compare with

start.privacy: Files stay on this computer. A backup is made before every save.
start.faqRpgMaker: RPG Maker: the game's save/ folder, or www/save/
start.pasteHint: Browser game? Paste the save code it gave you (Ctrl+V).

banner.readOnly: This file can't be written safely yet. You can look, but not save.
banner.semantic: The file will be written with a slightly different layout. The content stays the same.
banner.renpySigned: Ren'Py save: after you save changes, the game asks whether to trust this save. Answer Yes.
banner.renpyKeySigned: Ren'Py save: changes are signed with your own Ren'Py key.
banner.renpyPersistentKeySigned: Ren'Py persistent data: changes are signed with your own Ren'Py key.
banner.renpyPersistentSigned: This Ren'Py persistent data is signed. The game would throw away an edited copy, so it is open read-only.

bottom.openJsonInfo: Shows the whole file as JSON text. You can change values there and apply them.
bottom.backupsTip: Backups of this file: see them and put one back
bottom.overwriteItem: Overwrite current file (backup is made first)
bottom.backupInfo: A backup copy of the original is stored before any file is replaced.
bottom.invalidTip: Fix the highlighted values before saving.
bottom.copyCodeTip: Copy the edited save code to paste into your game

confirm.discardOpen_one: Discard {{count}} change and open another file?
confirm.discardOpen_other: Discard {{count}} changes and open another file?
confirm.discardBody: Your unsaved changes will be lost.

json.title: JSON editor
json.readOnlyNote: This file is read-only, so changes to the JSON cannot be applied.
json.failed: The JSON view could not be created.
json.editNote: Change values, then Apply. Fields, list items and placeholders such as <12 bytes> stay as they are.
json.exportApplyFirst: Apply or undo your edits first. Export saves the applied values.
json.dirty: Edited. Apply to use these values.
json.confirmBody: Your edits in the JSON text are not applied yet.

problem.unexpected: This is not a value. Use a number, text in quotes, true, false or null.
problem.expectedKey: Expected a field name in quotes.
problem.unclosedString: This text has no closing quote.
problem.controlChar: Write line breaks and tabs inside text as \n and \t.
problem.badNumber: This number is not written correctly.
problem.trailing: There is more text after the end of the JSON.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Copies of {{name}} made before it was saved over, newest first.
backups.retention_one: Only the last backup of each file is kept, for up to 30 days.
backups.retention_other: The last {{count}} backups of each file are kept, for up to 30 days.
backups.empty: No backups of this file yet. A backup is made each time you save over it.
backups.failed: The backups could not be read.
backups.confirmBody: {{name}} will be replaced by the backup from {{time}}. The current file is backed up first, so you can go back to it from this list.
backups.confirmLoss_one: Your {{count}} unsaved change will be lost.
backups.confirmLoss_other: Your {{count}} unsaved changes will be lost.

compare.title: Compare with {{name}}
compare.description: The other save is opened read-only. Nothing is written; a row you click only jumps to that value here.
compare.failed: The file could not be compared.
compare.empty: The two saves have the same values.
compare.goTo: Show this value in the editor

locations.title: Where is my save?
locations.description: SavePrism does not scan your PC. These are the usual places; open one and look for the game's folder. <game> and <company> stand for the game's own folder names.
locations.openFailed: The folder could not be opened
locations.failed: The save locations could not be read.

engine.rpgmaker-classic: RPG Maker XP / VX / VX Ace / 2000 / 2003

note.rpgmaker-mv: MV uses www/save; MZ uses save.
note.rpgmaker-classic: The save can be in the game's folder or in its Save folder.
note.wolf-rpg: Saves are in the Save folder inside the game's folder.
note.unity: PlayerPrefs live in the Windows registry: export them with regedit.
note.unreal: The project name is the game's folder name.
note.renpy: Saves can also be in game/saves inside the game's folder.
note.twine: Browser storage: use the game's Save to disk / export option.
note.witcher3: The Documents folder may be moved to OneDrive.
note.terraria: Players holds the characters; Worlds holds the worlds. The Documents folder may be moved to OneDrive.

password.title: This file is encrypted
password.body: Enter the password or game key used for {{name}}. It is used once and never stored.
password.label: Password
password.pickFolderTitle: Pick the folder where the game is installed
password.folderEmpty: No password found in that folder.
password.wrong: That password did not open the file. Check it, or pick the game folder so its own files can be searched.

settings.title: Settings
settings.patternInfo: A faint lattice behind the app. Turn it off for a plain background.
settings.defaultActionInfo: Choose what the main Save button does. The other option stays in its menu.
settings.keepBackupsInfo: How many backups of the file you save are kept (1 to 50), for up to 30 days. Older ones of that file are removed on the next save; the newest is always kept.
settings.showRecentInfo: Shows the last 5 files on the start screen. The list is stored on this computer only.
settings.aiToolsInfo: AI apps such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Cursor can open and edit saves through SavePrism. Saving always makes a backup first. Chat sites such as ChatGPT cannot connect: use Ask AI on any list to copy its values for them.
settings.showNotificationsInfo: Shows the bell with the events of this session.

about.title: About SavePrism
about.privacy: Files stay on this computer. Backups are kept in %LOCALAPPDATA%\SavePrism\backups.
